mapper.sql: select a.assessment_id, a.visitor_id, a.questionnaire_id, a.questionnaire_code, a.questionnaire_version, a.request_id, a.channel_code, a.client_platform, a.policy_code, a.policy_version, a.consent_time, a.assessment_status, cast(a.answers as text) as answers, cast(a.flags as text) as flags, a.is_minor, a.current_screen, a.submitted_time, a.del_flag, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark from abr_assessment a
mapper.select: where a.visitor_id = #{visitorId} and a.request_id = #{requestId} and a.del_flag = '0'

where a.visitor_id = #{visitorId} and a.questionnaire_code = #{questionnaireCode} and a.assessment_status = 'in_progress' and a.del_flag = '0' order by a.update_time desc nulls last, a.assessment_id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into abr_assessment (visitor_id, questionnaire_id, questionnaire_code, questionnaire_version, request_id, channel_code, client_platform, policy_code, policy_version, consent_time, assessment_status, answers, flags, is_minor, current_screen, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_time) values (#{visitorId}, #{questionnaireId}, #{questionnaireCode}, #{questionnaireVersion}, #{requestId}, coalesce(#{channelCode}, 'direct'), coalesce(#{clientPlatform}, ''), coalesce(#{policyCode}, ''), #{policyVersion}, now(), 'in_progress', coalesce(cast(#{answers} as jsonb), '{}'::jsonb), '{}'::jsonb, 'N', '', '0', '', now(), now())
mapper.update:
update abr_assessment set answers = (answers - array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(cast(#{removed} as jsonb)))) || cast(#{set} as jsonb), flags = flags || cast(#{flags} as jsonb), is_minor = case when (flags || cast(#{flags} as jsonb)) ->> 'is_minor' = 'true' then 'Y' else 'N' end,
current_screen = #{currentScreen},
update_time = now() where assessment_id = #{assessmentId} and assessment_status = 'in_progress' and del_flag = '0'

update abr_assessment set assessment_status = 'terminated',
answers = '{}'::jsonb, current_screen = '',
flags = flags || cast(#{flags} as jsonb), update_time = now() where assessment_id = #{assessmentId} and assessment_status = 'in_progress' and del_flag = '0'

update abr_assessment set assessment_status = 'submitted', answers = cast(#{answers} as jsonb), submitted_time = now(), update_time = now() where assessment_id = #{assessmentId} and assessment_status = 'in_progress' and del_flag = '0'
